---
title: "Summary · The outer delivery loop"
---

## Key takeaways

- The **outer delivery loop** has four stages that begin exactly
  where the Sandcastle ends: **review / PR**, **merge**, **GitOps
  delivery**, and **downstream Crossplane reconciliation**.
- The **only artifact that crosses the boundary** between the
  Sandcastle and the outer loop is the durable Git branch produced
  by the [previous lesson's hand-off](../01-handing-off-to-kubernetes/index.qmd).
  Everything the outer loop does is derived from that branch or
  supplied by the environment.
- Three guardrails surround the outer loop and all live **outside
  the Sandcastle boundary**: **automated verification** and
  **review** attach to the PR, **policy** attaches at cluster
  admission before Crossplane sees the XR.
- **Cluster reconciliation remains Crossplane's job.** The outer
  loop hands the XR over once and does not try to short-circuit
  composition from the delivery side — the same rule the
  [Hello Pico on Kubernetes lab](../../../../labs/hello-pico-on-kubernetes/)
  already relies on in isolation.
- The academy ships runnable coverage of the **endpoints** of this
  picture — the
  [Sandcastle → Kubernetes hand-off lab](../../../../labs/handoff-sandcastle-to-kubernetes/)
  at stage 0 and the
  [Hello Pico on Kubernetes lab](../../../../labs/hello-pico-on-kubernetes/)
  at stage 4. Stages 1–3 (review, merge, GitOps delivery) are
  **inspectable in the environment repository today** but are not
  yet packaged as a single reusable outer-loop lab.

## What comes next

- Part 3 will continue with lessons on **multi-artifact hand-offs**
  and on **packaging the outer loop as a runnable lab**. See
  [Part 3](../index.qmd) for the current scaffolded outline.
- Downstream cluster verification of the composed artifact continues
  to live in
  [`labs/hello-pico-on-kubernetes/`](../../../../labs/hello-pico-on-kubernetes/),
  and the hand-off that seeds the outer loop continues to live in
  [`labs/handoff-sandcastle-to-kubernetes/`](../../../../labs/handoff-sandcastle-to-kubernetes/).
- Policy tooling (OPA, Kyverno, Gatekeeper) and GitOps tooling
  (Flux, Argo CD) are named here as concrete examples of the
  outer-loop guardrail and delivery stages; specific tool
  walkthroughs are natural extensions for later Part 3 lessons.
